## Scam Alert: Be Aware of Unsolicited Calls


### Virginia National Bank reminds our clients to be cautious of financial scams.


Fraudsters are calling clients claiming to be VNB employees and requesting login credentials and personal information.


**Virginia National Bank will NEVER ask our clients to provide:**


- Personal Identification Number (PIN) or security codes
- Bank account information or log in credentials
- Personal information once your account is opened


**We will NEVER ask you to send payments anywhere.**


Stay safe with these tips:


- Delete suspicious messages
- Don’t click links or share personal info
- Contact us if you’ve shared details
- Report unusual calls, texts, emails, and links to us


Click[here](https://www.vnb.com/service-center/cybersecurity-alerts) for more tips on how to protect your accounts.


Stay alert and contact us directly at877.817.8621 if you have any questions or concerns.
